title: Banco Master Scandal Injects Chaos into Brazil's Presidential Race
detail: Al Jazeera's longform investigation reveals the Banco Master financial scandal is reshaping political alignments ahead of Brazil's election cycle, adding to existing tensions between Lula and Bolsonarista forces. The scandal has become a major disruptive factor in the 2026 presidential race.
